what: A section: the newsroom as one audience reads it. The words are the editor's; the placement is admin/build/sections.py's, from articles/find.json (desks, controlled tags, formats, series) and admin/content/features.json. Change this file, not the page. `exclude` lists articles the rules would place but the editor keeps out, each with the reason. Streams are tried in order and an article goes in the first one it matches; a stream matches if any of its clauses does, and a clause matches if all its conditions do.
title: For publishers
for_whom: For editors, publishers and anyone running a news business who wants to see what a newsroom built with agents looks like, how it gets paid, and what they could copy.
intro: This site is a newsroom that runs in the open: written from the editor's voice memos by a desk of agents, every source linked, every version kept, read with a meter that charges for what was read. It changes most days. This section keeps the pieces a publisher needs in one place, and it keeps itself current: new articles are placed here by their tags and desk as they are published, and new features appear as they ship.
